title: DQC-2stap questionnaire: assessment module for two-state approaches to quantum physics teaching
description: The Development of Quantum Concepts via different two-state approaches (DQC-2stap) project developed a questionnaire to assess student understanding of the measurement process in quantum physics within two-state teaching approaches. The questionnaire uses mostly two-tier items (closed single choice plus explanation) supplemented by a few open items. It was administered to students of existing two-state-approach courses in Hungary, Slovenia and Italy, with results analysed using an iteratively developed coding scheme.
requirements: Only minor modifications needed to concretise particular questions to the context of the approach
Teacher training courses to prepare for implementation
constraints: Initially restricted to the concept of measurement in quantum physics to limit complexity
target_learning_goals: understanding of the measuring process in quantum mechanics
examples: A teacher training course was developed and conducted in Udine (Italy), consisting of 5 meetings of 4 hours each, once a week, completed in March 2022
